big_case.notes: Solicitor General petition challenging the D.C. Circuit's invalidation of President Trump's flagship southern-border entry-suspension and asylum-bar proclamation (Proclamation No. 10,888), testing the interplay of 8 U.S.C. 1182(f), 1185(a), 1158(a)(1), and Title 8 removal procedures alongside 8 U.S.C. 1252(f)(1)'s bar on classwide injunctive relief; granted plenary review on Questions 1 and 2, placing it in the upper marquee tier of OT2026 while preserving headroom near 1.0 for once-in-a-generation constitutional landmarks.

leakage.notes: Forward prediction placed on 2026-08-24 (run_id 20260824T231410Z, result_capture_coverage=0.9118), the day the petition was docketed and nearly three months before the 2026-11-13 grant order. Logged calls read provisioned arrival inputs, metrics/statpack.md, and CourtListener records for the June 25, 2026 comparator opinion Mullin v. Al Otro Lado (No. 25-5); no read touched data/qp-topics/.

central_claims.basis: outcome.json and record/snapshots/2026-11-13.json show distribution for the 11/6/2026 conference, one relist to the 11/13/2026 conference (distribution_count=2, cvsg_date=null), and a grant on November 13, 2026.
central_claims.claim: The petition will be distributed at least once and will probably be granted after its initial conference or one relist, with no CVSG.

central_claims.basis: The November 13, 2026 order in record/snapshots/2026-11-13.json granted certiorari 'limited to Questions 1 and 2 presented by the petition,' matching the predicted ordering though QP 2 was hedged as 'may add.'
central_claims.claim: The Court will most likely grant Question 1, may add the Section 1252(f)(1) Question 2, and is less likely to grant the Article III and Rule 23 Question 3 independently.
Plenary briefing and argument are more likely than a summary disposition, although a GVR or narrow summary ruling remains a material alternative.

central_claims.basis: Certiorari was granted on November 13, 2026, leaving the denial branch untested and merits proceedings still pending beyond the staged record.
central_claims.claim: If the Court reaches the merits after a plenary grant, it is likely to reverse on at least one ground; if certiorari is denied instead, the likeliest denial will carry no separate writing.
